description: This is a Java source file defining the LogView class, which extends TextView and implements LogNode interface. It is used to display log messages received from different components in an Android application, formatting log data and updating the UI accordingly.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data, formatted with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and chains to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors initializing LogView with different parameter sets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and updates the LogView UI; forwards log message to the next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with delimiter if they are not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
